set.body:
Outcome: an ordinary local configuration runs, inspects and exports registered reference-only mappings with the same input/publication safeguards as paired runs.
Scope: MappingPipeline, MappingSettings, CLI/settings, batch/exchange manifests and independent reader examples; consume F authority.
Acceptance: explicit mode selects reference-only without computing or serializing reconstruction or requesting a grouping. Lexical/caption/ONNX origins retain their existing admission and registration checks; unsupported combinations refuse explicitly. All attempts and unavailable rows use A accounting; B metadata identifies actual kind/policy. Independent reader recovers records and rejects corruption/foreign execution; replay/resume and interrupted/partial/all-failed batches stay safe. Paired mode remains compatible per D. Organization/temporal consumer support is explicitly enumerated in D and tested where promised; unimplemented capabilities refuse without fabricating results. An ordinary fixture command demonstrates success where reconstruction grouping would refuse, plus paired-reference numeric agreement. Use H's benchmark harness when available to record reference-only work/time/memory against matched paired inputs; record missing baseline as a performance limitation, not an implementation blocker.
Evidence: public CLI/settings/batch/exchange tests, outside-package authority/readback tests, relevant consumer gates and reproducible example with exact artifacts.

Delivery rules: claim this bounded child with an explicit actor and mote begin before implementation; reserve only affected paths. One writer and at most one independent helper, one heavy gate at a time. No change to protected data admission, calibration authority or existing scientific acceptance. For code changes, compute scope with bash tools/reference-scope.sh BASE_SHA CANDIDATE_SHA in a verified standalone clone/export, use CI fatal warnings, all affected platforms and StoryAtlas checks for consumed surfaces. Record exact SHA, commands, exits and Passed/Failed/skipped totals; format last. Require independent exact-SHA review (SD2/SD6), external-package construction probes for new checked boundaries and named compiling mutation kills for new guards. Documentation-only work uses T2 review and format/integrity checks. Close only after the accepted slice lands within owner authorization; distinguish local, hosted and consumer evidence. Split further before editing if a child exceeds about one day. No publication/release or main movement is authorized by this planning request.
set.title: [mapping audit G] Deliver ordinary reference-only configuration, batch export and readback
